lessonTitle: 27. Derivatives of a sum and a product
lessonTitleEnglish: Derivatives of a sum and a product
unit: Algebra · Chapter 5. Continuity and the derivative
source: Based on the topics of the Armenian grade 11 mathematics textbooks (advanced stream)

stages.headline: (u + v)' = u' + v' and (Cu)' = Cu'; for example (x² + 5x)' = 2x + 5.
stages.headlineEnglish: (u + v)' = u' + v' and (Cu)' = Cu'; for example (x² + 5x)' = 2x + 5.

stages.headline: The power rule: (xⁿ)' = nxⁿ⁻¹; e.g. (x⁵)' = 5x⁴ and (3x⁴ − 2x)' = 12x³ − 2.
stages.headlineEnglish: The power rule: (xⁿ)' = nxⁿ⁻¹; e.g. (x⁵)' = 5x⁴ and (3x⁴ − 2x)' = 12x³ − 2.

stages.headline: The product rule: (uv)' = u'v + uv'; e.g. (x²(x + 1))' = 2x(x + 1) + x² = 3x² + 2x.
stages.headlineEnglish: The product rule: (uv)' = u'v + uv'; e.g. (x²(x + 1))' = 2x(x + 1) + x² = 3x² + 2x.
